title: Amendments to the orders (the generic library)
description: GH-1395 (design 2026-11-15-challenge-star-design.md §3.1; lead rulings D8, D11 of 16 Nov 2026): the generic amendments, each an id, its English label and blurb (data text, like a mission's name and briefing: they ride the lazily loaded challenge chunk, never the entry chunk's en.json) and a list of operations from the CLOSED set in overlay_ops.schema.json, applied by `applyOverlays` after the difficulty posture. Every amendment is a RESTRICTION (rule A1): tools/validate_challenges.mjs refuses, per operation (`restrictionFailure`), anything that does not point the restricting way, and tools/src/challenges.test.ts bounds creditsFor's inputs. A mission offers three (data/challenges/<mission>.json), from this library or from its own `own` list, whose items share this shape.

label.description: Player-facing text, English source (data text, like a mission's name: no en.json key, so the copy rides the lazily loaded challenge chunk and never the entry chunk).
